O.content: The bar labeled "Groundwater" is higher on the page than the bars labeled "Surface water", "Desalination", "Recycled water", and "Rain capture".
The chart title reads "Urban Water Supply by Source" and the y-axis label reads "Reported supply share (%)".

B.text: If each source’s bar height on the vertical scale encodes its urban reported supply contribution, and the routing criterion requires escalation of the largest contribution source, select the option for the source with the tallest bar.
B.conditions: Applies only if bar geometry, rather than the conflicting percentage annotations above the bars, is the authoritative contribution encoding.

B.text: If the percentage inscription directly above each source bar is the authoritative reported supply-share value, compare those inscriptions; under the stated largest-contribution routing criterion, select the option for the source with the greatest printed share.
B.conditions: Applies if the bold percentages are valid source-specific reported supply shares; this conflicts with the bar heights.
